# Jugaaadi Table

> Open source React spreadsheet component built on TanStack Table v8.

## What it is

@jugaaadi/table is a free, MIT-licensed React component that adds spreadsheet functionality to any React application. It provides editable cells, a formula engine, cell merging, rich formatting, 15+ column types, find & replace, CSV export/import, undo/redo, and a blank-sheet mode.

## Install

```
npm install @jugaaadi/table
```

## Key features

- Editable cells with 15+ column types (text, number, date, select, checkbox, rating, currency, percentage, email, URL, phone, image, file, color, progress)
- Formula engine with cross-sheet references using @ syntax
- Cell merging (colspan and rowspan)
- Rich formatting: background/text colors, borders, fonts, bold/italic/underline, text alignment
- Find & replace across sheets
- CSV export and import
- Undo/redo with full history
- Column pinning, sorting, grouping, resizing
- Row freezing and pagination
- Blank-sheet mode for building spreadsheets from scratch
- List mode for read-only tabular display with horizontal scrolling
